We have target molecule with TBS protecting groups? The SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

Let's parse: It appears to have a cyclic diol (maybe a protected diol?) Actually there is O attached to C1 (hydroxyl). Then O[C@@H]... there is an O attached to side chain? The SMILES includes O[C@H]1... and O[C@@H]([...]) maybe both are free OH? No TBS groups present. The guidance mentions TBS protecting group steps. So we need to propose a 5-step retrosynthesis route using the given transformations: TBS protection, DIBAL-H reduction, HWE, Still-Gennari, etc. The forward reactions described: TBS protection (adds TBS, breaks O-H, forms O-Si). DIBAL-H reduces ester to aldehyde (break C=O double bond to C-O single, forms aldehyde). HWE forms alkene from aldehyde + phosphonate (forms C=C). Still-Gennari forms Z-alkene from aldehyde + phosphonate (similar). So we need to propose a route of 5 reactions to synthesize target.

We need to produce a JSON retrosynthesis tree with 5 reaction steps. Each reaction node includes template_id (we need actual IDs). We have one template ID from search: reaction_id 29646 corresponds to deprotection of TBS? Actually retro_smarts_template: [C:2]-[OH]>>C-C(-C)(-C)-[Si](-C)(-C)-[O;H0;D2;+0:1]-[C:2] meaning forward: TBS protected alcohol to free alcohol? The retro template shows breaking O-Si to give OH. So applying retrosynthesis, we can go from product (free OH) to precursor (TBS protected). So we can use template_id 29646.

We need other templates for other steps: DIBAL-H reduction of ester to aldehyde: need template where ester -> aldehyde. Search for functional_groups_broken: "carboxylic esters", formed: "aldehydes". Let's search.
